text:
kevin: Quick thought — can we add a 'Snapshot preview' toggle to per-route saved views so engineers can preview telemetry-weighted samples before saving? cc @maria @tara

maria: Love that. Can the preview surface estimated cost + sample rate? Also want a per-model breakdown in the modal.

tara: Do we mean per-route primary preview or a per-model view? worried about adding UI clutter. Suggest compact flyout that expands per-model.

kevin: Per-route as primary, with expandable per-model rows. Mock uploaded: https://redwood.example.com/screenshot/preview-1.png. Also show quota hint if preview would consume sampling budget :warning:.

maria: UX suggestion: button text 'Preview samples' -> opens modal with small table (sample id, model, timestamp, token_count) + sparkline. Add 'Export CSV' and 'Save from preview' CTA. :thumbsup: 

josh: Backend note: propose endpoint GET /api/v1/console/preview-samples?route_id=...&model=...&cost_estimate=true. Need to gate this with rate limits and a short cache TTL.

maria: We should reuse the existing route-sampler service and add a lightweight cost estimator rather than a new heavy query path.

kevin: Frontend flow idea: modal triggers route-sampler with param cost_estimate=true. If estimator isn't available return 'Estimate unavailable' but still show samples.

tara: Rollout plan: feature flag console.preview_samples, gradual rollout to 10% orgs. Telemetry events: preview_open, preview_export, preview_cost_mismatch. Admin guard for orgs with custom sampling policies.

josh: I can add an endpoint wrapper that calls route-sampler + estimator. Estimator will approximate cost using median token_count distribution per-route. We'll include a boolean `estimation_approx` if based on heuristics.

maria: Small UX ask — let users pin a sample snapshot to saved-query metadata so it's reproducible (e.g., metadata key sampled_preview_v=1).

kevin: Agree. Keep saved queries as normal objects but attach metadata when saved from preview.

tara: Docs blurb: "Preview shows representative sampled requests — not live production outputs. Use Export for offline audit." I'll add help text and tooltip.

kevin: I'll sketch modal tomorrow and post Figma link. tagging @eng-ml for model-specific gotchas.

Example frontend call:
```
fetch(`/api/v1/console/preview-samples?route_id=R123&model=gpt-neo-1&cost_estimate=true`)
  .then(r => r.json())
  .then(renderPreviewModal)
```

reactions: kevin:+1, maria:+1, tara:eyes
